title: ui_text
summary: MSUI's GameTextLaw/GameText/FontObjectLaw transcribe the same byte-verified 1.12 text laws Benilla derived: raster size clamp(round(h/768*deviceH),2,32), per-glyph floor(advance)+1 tracking (+1 more for THICK outline, baked per instance), line pitch = em with zero spacing, named FrameXML font objects with face/height/color/shadow/outline, DPI-aware atlas bake, and chat word-wrap to the message width. Both accept the same stb/FreeType hinting divergence.

openItems.text: No inline markup parsing anywhere: |cAARRGGBB / |r color escapes are not resolved (server- or DBC-supplied colored strings, e.g. quality-color prefixes, would render as literal escape text), where Benilla's markup.rs splits lines into color runs with malformed-escape passthrough.
No |H...|h hyperlink support: item/player links in chat are neither styled, clickable, nor shift-click insertable (Benilla carries LinkInfo through every wrapped run).
|T...|t inline-texture escapes are not stripped, so such a string would show raw markup instead of silently dropping the texture reference.
No general FontString overflow/ellipsize law (Benilla's layout/overflow.rs ellipsize_to_fit) - truncation behavior outside chat wrap is per-panel ad hoc.
